system.notes:
BacteriTech™ FAB-Ultraviolet: glows under ultraviolet light. Lightly flood an area you suspect an astral intruder has entered, then light it with UV: the intruder displaces the glowing bacteria and casts a revealing "shadow". It lives three to four hours once released. Shipped frozen; once out of the freezer it begins to die and can't be reused. The 5,000 m³ canister can take underbarrel mounts for the FAB-Netgun.

In Foundry: add a Fat bacteria zone behaviour with strain FAB-UV; when the UV lights are on, the GM runs the search from the behaviour's settings (Perception TN 6, +1 per 50 m², −1 per two searchers; CSH p.103).

Corporate Security Handbook p.83.
